job.title: Recruitment Operations Lead
job.city: Melbourne CBD & Inner Suburbs Melbourne VIC
job.description:
LOVE tech, process and people? Eager to shape how a boutique agency works behind the scenes and out front?

Then look no further….

  • Own our recruitment technology, from ATS and CRM, through to automation and system rollouts
  • Hands on Operations role - working with the Director and Recruitment Manager
  • Part time or full position, with flexibility for start/finish times
  • CBD location with WFH flexibility after the probation period
  • Attractive salary package on offer
  • Work in a fun, dynamic culture
  • Morning teas, lunches and company events & activities
  • Learning and professional development opportunities


About Us

Hugo Personnel is an Australian owned and managed, corporate recruitment agency. We work alongside our sister company, Inter Staffing Services, to provide temporary and permanent staff to our exceptional partners. We recruit in the areas of finance and accounting, administration and office support, call centre and customer service, human resources, and marketing and communications.

Our office is located right in the heart of the CBD, very close to public transport, with work from home flexibility after the probation period.


The Role

Reporting to the Director and Recruitment Manager, you will be the champion user of our core recruitment systems. You will review and refine our tech stack, lead rollouts and training, keep our data clean and compliant, and bring the team along for the ride. You will also draw on your recruitment knowledge to support our consultants, step in on escalations and occasionally recruit senior roles.

Your main responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Review and refine the company tech stack, lead system rollouts and integrations
  • Act as champion user and first point of contact for all recruitment systems
  • Analyse recruitment processes and workflows, and find opportunities for automation and optimisation
  • Facilitate onboarding and training for new and existing staff, including the leadership team
  • Refine training collateral, automation templates and instructional design packages
  • Assist with internal recruitment for new team members
  • Maintain data hygiene and produce ATS reports
  • Support weekly social media content, create EDMs, nurture pathways and marketing analytics
  • Support the Recruitment Manager with higher duties, senior role recruitment and client escalations
  • Collaborate with the Directors, IT Manager and Payroll Manager to manage our software vendors

What you need to succeed?

  • Demonstrated experience in an agency environement
  • Proven experience rolling out a CRM, ATS or HRIS
  • Demonstrated experience as a Senior Recruiter and/ or Operations Team Lead
  • Strong working knowledge of an ATS and CRM, including automation builders or APIs, and the confidence to train others
  • Strong influencing skills, with the ability to bring stakeholders into change
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience facilitating workshops and training for staff at all levels
  • Sound understanding of compliance in a recruitment settings
  • Ability to adapt when priorities change, including balancing the needs of two businesses
  • Understanding of marketing and brand awareness (not essential)

Come join our close knit and energetic team who work hard but also have a lot of fun and laughs along the way.

Interviews will be held immediately.
